thread:
Mike: Quick heads-up — PR #3124 (rename + gofumpt tweak) is blocked by a formatter edge in the generated protos. I split the formatter exemption into a tiny patch but need an infra owner approve to land. Can someone from @Raj or @Elaine take a look? Thanks :pray:
Sarah: What's the failing output? I can try running it locally.
Mike: repro steps: `make proto` then `gofumpt ./...` — it rewrites some generated field names (`FooBAR` -> `FooBar`). It's purely formatting churn in `gen/protos/*.go`. Snippet below:
Mike: ```diff
-    // generated
-    FooBAR string
+    // generated
+    FooBar string
```
Raj: Ugh, generator quirk. Is this an actual rename or only formatting? If it's only fmt churn we can accept a format-only commit.
Mike: Only fmt churn. I added `// gofumpt:ignore` for the generated file in this branch and updated CI to skip gofumpt on `gen/protos/*` for this PR so bots stop flapping.
CI-bot: premerge checks: gofumpt failed on gen/protos/service.pb.go (line 123) — details: https://ci.internal/xyz (run id 4628888899)
Elaine: I can sign off but would prefer a short comment in the generator code to avoid future flips. Can you add that and a tiny test asserting `make proto` is idempotent?
Mike: Yep — added a comment in `tools/proto-gen/README.md` and a quick idempotency test in `tools/proto-gen/test_idempotent.sh`. Pushed the commit.
Sarah: Re-running CI now, will queue the job.
Sarah: queued job 4628888919 — linking here so it's easy to find.
CI-bot: premerge checks: all checks passed ✅ (build, unit tests, gofumpt) — run id 4628888920
Elaine: LGTM from infra/security side. approving now.
Raj: Squash and merge once CI is green. Also add a short changelog line about generated protos exemption.
Mike: Will squash and land in the next 30-min merge window, canary to staging first and monitor. Thanks everyone!
Sarah: :thumbsup:
Mike: Follow-up: merged main at 4628888921 and canary deployed to staging. Will watch metrics for the hour and escalate if anything odd.
